name: Experience
description: XP and leveling system. Characters with a 'level' trait gain XP and level up automatically.
author: Nekon

mc_id.tooltip: Character id of the MC. Their level is snapshotted as the dungeon level on first entry of each level group.

auto_scaling.tooltip: Enables dungeon-level scaling: level snapshots on dungeon entry, dungeon-bound inventory creation, equipment instance scaling, and level-scaled threat. Off = plain XP and leveling only.

shared_level.tooltip: Party-wide progression: a numeric xp action grants the whole party (off = the MC only), and a character joining the party is levelled up to the MC's level and XP, receiving every level-up bonus on the way (requires a level trait).

power_scale_per_level.tooltip: Item + reward scaling per dungeon level (the power curve): effective threat = base threat × (1 + power_scale_per_level × (dungeon_level − 1)). Also scales equipment stats and ability enhancements. (Enemy scaling is separate — see the enemy dungeon-scale curve.)

price_scale_per_level.tooltip: Price growth per level for scaled equipment, independent of the power curve. Empty = twice power_scale_per_level (gear value climbs faster than its power, so old gear sells for less relative to replacements). Set equal to power_scale_per_level to weld value to power.

loot_equipment_coef.tooltip: Equipment loot budget = BASE battle threat x this. Not level-scaled: created equipment instances scale their own stats/value to the dungeon level. 0 disables the group.

loot_income_coef.tooltip: Income loot budget = EFFECTIVE battle threat (level-scaled) x this, plus the equipment group's unspent remainder; spent on income-category items, and whatever stays unspent pays out as the currency item. 0 disables the group (a pure equipment remainder still pays out).

loot_gold_share.tooltip: Fraction (0-1) of the income pot paid straight out as the currency item before item rolls — battles visibly pay gold instead of converting the whole budget into items.

loot_max_items.tooltip: Maximum items each loot group can roll per reward.

gather_lower_tier_weight.tooltip: Gather spots (collect_pool: "gather"): weight in % kept by each ingredient tier below the dungeon level's own tier. Tiers open at level 1/4/7/10; e.g. at 40, a level-7 dungeon rolls tier 3 at weight 100, tier 2 at 40, tier 1 at 16.

smith_break_divisor.tooltip: Smith station break-down yield = floor(item level / this) × the item's rarity cost. Items below this level refund no stones and stay ordinary sellables.

smith_sound_upgrade.tooltip: Sound played when an item is reforged at the smith station. Empty = silent.

smith_sound_break.tooltip: Sound played when an item is broken down at the smith station. Empty = silent.

loot_equipment_categories.tooltip: Item categories the equipment loot group rolls from (and that scale to the dungeon level on creation).

loot_income_categories.tooltip: Item categories the income loot group rolls from (e.g. sellable junk). Empty = the whole income budget pays out as the currency item.

loot_currency_item.tooltip: Currency item paid out from the leftover income budget.

reward_sound_open.tooltip: Sound played when the reward panel appears. Empty = silent.

reward_sound_level_up.tooltip: Sound played on each level-up rollover of the reward panel's XP bar. Empty = silent.

threat_xp_coef.tooltip: XP granted to the party per point of effective threat when a battle is defeated (fight or scripted win). 0 disables defeat XP.

xp_base.tooltip: XP threshold to level up at level 1.

xp_formula.tooltip: How XP threshold scales per level. See the docs for specific formulas.

xp_growth.tooltip: Growth percentage applied per level to the XP threshold.

xp_table.tooltip: Custom XP thresholds per level (index 0 = level 1). Levels beyond the table use the last entry.

level_up_rewards.tooltip: Currency items (e.g., ability points) awarded to the character's private inventory on each level up. Only items with 'is_currency' enabled appear.

item_id.tooltip: Currency item to award (e.g., skill points).

enemy_scaling.tooltip: Enemy dungeon-scale curve: pins of {level, coef} that multiply every enemy's base health and power at battle start. A dungeon level uses the CLOSEST PIN AT OR BELOW it, so pins are sparse steps, not a per-level table — e.g. [{1,1},{3,2}] leaves levels 1-2 unscaled and doubles from level 3 on. No pin at or below the level means no scaling. Composes MULTIPLICATIVELY with the battle difficulty setting: final = base × coef × (1 + difficulty%). Separate from power_scale_per_level, which scales the player's gear and rewards, so the two curves can be tuned against each other.

level.tooltip: Dungeon level this pin starts at. Applies until the next pin.

coef.tooltip: Multiplier on the enemy's base health and power. 1 = unchanged, 2 = double.

no_scale_stats.tooltip: Stats the item level curve never multiplies. Use for percentage-natured stats that are already proportional (reflect, dodge, crit chance) — scaling those compounds instead of keeping pace. Flat stats (power, thorns, armor, health) should stay scaled.

gather_categories.tooltip: Item categories a gather spot may yield. Empty = reagents + ingredient. Items still need a herb/fungus tag and a matching environment.

id.tooltip: Environment id referenced by dungeons and ingredients (e.g. 'cave', 'forest', 'mansion').

description.tooltip: What counts as this environment. Authoring reference only — never shown in game.

character_stats.name: XP Modifier
character_stats.description: Percent modifier to XP gain. 0 = normal (100%), 20 = +20%, -50 = halved.

character_traits.tooltip: Character's current level. Set in character template to enable XP/leveling.
Status to apply on each level up. Stacks automatically – each level adds one stack. Use for stat growth per level.

locale.val: You need to reach level |level| to equip |item|.
The forge is cold – bring smith stones.
The smith works on what is in the bag – bring unequipped leveled gear.
|item| will be destroyed – there is no way to undo this. Break it down for |amount| smith stones?

dungeon_traits.description: Dungeons sharing this group share one level snapshot, taken on first entry of any of them. Convention: name it after the group's main dungeon id.

Environment of this dungeon for gather spots (defined in the Environments tab). Random collectables only draw ingredients whose environments trait lists it (or ingredients with none, which grow everywhere).

item_traits.description: Minimum level for generated drops and shop stock (dungeon level for loot, MC level for trade). Empty = no floor. Authored drop tables and inventories ignore it.
Maximum level for generated drops and shop stock (dungeon level for loot, MC level for trade). Empty = no ceiling. Authored drop tables and inventories ignore it.
Environments this ingredient grows in (defined in the Environments tab), matched against the dungeon trait environment at gather spots. Empty = grows everywhere.
Stamped at runtime on a hybrid trader's authored signature stock so restocks re-roll only the pooled items around it. Declared so the save migration keeps the stamp; never author it on a template.

inventory_traits.description: Instantiated on first entry of this dungeon (or any dungeon sharing its level group). Items are created and locked there, picking up the dungeon level.

Pool entries drawn into this inventory on top of its authored items when it is instantiated (chance mode, one draw per entity). Each entry draws independently, so a container can combine a value tier with a place: ["chest2", "place_nest"] is a chest sitting in a nest.
Re-roll the pooled stock (authored items are kept) whenever the MC's level has changed since the last roll. For shops; leave off for chests so contents stay locked.

traits.name: Smith Stone
traits.description: Spend these at a smith station to reforge a piece of equipment to a higher level. Finer rarities require more stones per level.
